root_cause.text: The AMD display VBIOS parsers in bios_parser.c and bios_parser2.c walked record chains with unbounded `for (;;)` loops that trusted a malformed VBIOS to provide a `0xFF`/zero-size terminator, allowing endless traversal and eventual out-of-bounds struct reads near the BIOS image boundary.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states that “All record-chain walk loops ... use for(;;) and only terminate on a 0xFF record_type sentinel or zero record_size,” and that “A malformed VBIOS image missing the terminator record causes unbounded iteration ... [and] struct casts beyond the 2-byte header validated by GET_IMAGE can also read out of bounds”; the patch fixes this by replacing each `for (;;)` with `for (i = 0; i < BIOS_MAX_NUM_RECORD; i++)` and adding `#define BIOS_MAX_NUM_RECORD 256`.
